ReviewResult

VERDICT: FAIL

Findings:

- blocker, `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/page.tsx.tmpl:136`: The server-action forms send `checked`, but the action contract expects `ownerClass` and `nextChecked`. The submitted form will be rejected as non-toggleable / unknown owner class, so marking readiness items done or undone cannot work.

- blocker, `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/page.tsx.tmpl:139`: The visible checkbox does not submit the form. Clicking the checkbox or label only changes local input state; the only submit control is `sr-only` at line 151. This breaks the primary founder workflow for pointer/touch users and gives keyboard users an invisible focus target.

- major, `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/page.tsx.tmpl:178`: `DoneItemRow` renders toggle forms for every done item, but `groupReadinessItems` puts all `status === "done"` items into this group regardless of `owner_class`. Sprint-work or waiver items can therefore appear founder-toggleable even though they are not.

- major, `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/page.tsx.tmpl:292`: `readinessPhase` supports `warm`, but the page only renders `cold` and `all-done` FTUE states. The specified cold/warm/all-done panel behavior is incomplete.
